hooks.name: candidate-format-check
hooks.description: When a candidate/analysis file is saved, remind the agent to check the standard candidate format (ID, location, hypothesis, preconditions, impact+severity, evidence, verification) per .kiro/steering/bug-bounty.md.

action.prompt: Check the file that was just saved: does every candidate follow the standard format of steering bug-bounty.md (ID + title, file:function, falsifiable hypothesis, preconditions, impact + severity guess, code evidence, what must be verified)? Report any that do not comply; do not change them silently.
